title: aegoseris setosa
intro: Aegoseris setosa, commonly known as  Chrysanthemum setosum, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is native to East Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, valued for its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aegoseris setosa include reducing fever, relieving pain and inflammation, as well as treating various infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
